title: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc
summary: A 100-minute MAPPA theatrical sequel to the 12-episode TV series that adapts the owner's own instrument (Fujimoto's Chainsaw Man manga, printed chapter numbering) end to end: the complete Bomb Girl arc / レゼ篇, chapters 39-52 — the fandom's arc page and navibox give the arc as ch 39-52 (vols 5-6) and every one of those chapter pages carries the film in its `episode` field, while en-Wikipedia states the film 'adapts events covered by the original manga's fifth and sixth volumes' and its plot runs from Makima's movie-marathon date (ch 39) to Makima killing Reze in the alley (ch 52). The film's post-credits scene — Denji waiting at the café with a bouquet, Power arriving, Denji eating the flowers — is ch 52's own closing pages, not a teaser for ch 53, so coverage stops cleanly at the end of vol 6 and the manga continues at ch 53 (vol 7, International Assassins arc). The seam with S1 is contiguous with no gap: ep 12's END is ch 38 (fandom: ep 12 = ch 35 p.6-19, 36, 37, 38 p.2-22) and the Bomb Girl arc starts at the very next chapter; Aki's VA on the official site confirms the film is 「テレビアニメのストーリーの最後から地続き」, the events 'from the next day onward'. The one wrinkle: the film does open on material S1 already animated — two reviews describe a cold open of Denji's sealed-door dream in his apartment (Pochita heard, not seen) before the IRIS OUT title sequence, and that dream is chapter 38's closing pages, which ep 12's post-credits stinger already animated (en-WP's and the fandom's ep-12 summaries both describe it). Those are RE-SHOWN pages, so they are recorded as a restaged cold open and deliberately kept out of chapters_adapted rather than allowed to become a phantom START of 38. Nothing in the film is anime-original at a story-carrying scale (additions are expansions of adapted scenes, e.g. Reze's insert song 「ジェーンは教会で眠った」, which is ch 43's own chapter title), so the standing is plain canon under T28, not mixed.

chapters_adapted.note: the complete Bomb Girl arc (レゼ篇) in printed numbering: vol 5 ch 39 'Tearjerker' through vol 6 ch 52 'Lost Love, Flower, Chainsaw'; the post-credits café/bouquet scene is ch 52's closing pages, so the manga continues at ch 53 (vol 7). Adapted end to end — no chapter of the arc is skipped by any source read; compression of the Aki/Angel Devil subplot is `abridged`-style faithfulness, not original material

position.why: directly after ep 12, the S1 finale. The film is a direct sequel to the 12-episode TV series (AniList PREQUEL edge; en-WP 'a direct sequel to the first season') and adapts ch 39-52, the chapters immediately after ep 12's END of ch 38 — contiguous, no gap, no arc-level overlap. The official site's staff comment from Aki's VA Shogo Sakata says the film is 「テレビアニメのストーリーの最後から地続きなので、翌日からの出来事なんです」 ('directly continuous from the end of the TV anime's story — the events from the next day onward'). Nothing sits between: the S2 TV series チェンソーマン 刺客篇 (Assassins Arc) was announced 2025-12-21 and takes up ch 53+. 12.5 stands

flags_for_sean: THE ASK'S SEAM QUESTION, answered: the Bomb Girl arc sits IMMEDIATELY after the chapter S1 ended on — ep 12's END is ch 38 and the arc runs 39-52 (fandom Katana Man arc = ch 23-38 / eps 8-12; Bomb Girl arc = ch 39-52 / the film). No gap, no arc-level overlap, no skipped chapters between the two works.

YES, the film opens on material S1 already adapted, but as a RESTAGING, not coverage: two independent reviews put a cold open of Denji's sealed-door dream in his apartment before the IRIS OUT title sequence (kaijuunited: 'The story picks up following the end of the Katana Man arc, with Denji's motif dream in his apartment. Then, the audience is treated to a catchy intro sequence, IRIS OUT'; That Shelf: 'Reze Arc picks up almost immediately after the conclusion of the first season' / 'Pochita (heard, but not seen in an introductory dream sequence)'). That dream is ch 38's closing pages, and ep 12 already animated it (en-WP ep 12: 'Denji dreams of seeing a door in an alley, but Pochita's voice tells him not to open it'; the fandom's ep-12 summary the same). Re-shown pages are never coverage and never a position, and A47 keeps ch 38 as ep 12's END, so 38 is deliberately ABSENT from chapters_adapted — do not let it become a START of 38.

UNVERIFIED, named honestly: ch 38 is 25 pages and the fandom credits ep 12 with only p.2-22, so the very last page(s) — Denji waking and Power, blood-drunk, punching him across the room — may be first-time material in the film. No source I read describes that beat in the film (the reviews stop at the dream). If it matters later, the settling instrument is the film's first two minutes against ch 38 p.23-25.

PROVENANCE on the fandom's ch-38 tag (do not read it as a coverage claim): Chapter 38 now carries `episode = Episode 12 + the Movie` and `arc = Katana Man arc + Bomb Girl arc`, but the Movie link was added 2025-09-18T21:13Z by WitheredFreddy1993 inside a batch that stamped the film onto chs 38-52 as the film opened (an arc-scope edit, not an observation), and the `arc` half was added 2025-10-29 by Mojo72400 with the summary 'The ending counts as part of the Bomb Girl Arc' — an arc-boundary judgment. Single-lineage, single-source.

TOUCHES ep 12's ROW (outside this ask, no change proposed): until 2025-09-18 the same wiki carried `Chapter 52 (p.5)` on Episode 12 and `Episode 12 (partially)` on Chapter 52 — the finale's stinger shows Reze walking the alley toward the café with the town-mouse/country-mouse line over it. The editor removed both with 'The ending scene was more of a teaser when I rewatched it', which matches our own teaser/sliver class exactly: position-less, never an anchor, and ch 52 belongs to the film, which adapts it in full. Ep 12's END 38 stands.

ENRICHMENT AVAILABLE for the owner's grid (not applied here): the context shows ep 12 as '?-38' with no START and no continue. The fandom gives ep 12 = ch 35 (p.6-19), 36, 37, 38 (p.2-22) → START 35 (page-split with ep 11, whose stored anchor is 31-35). With this film taking 39-52, the series' post-film continue is ch 53 (vol 7, International Assassins arc) — where the announced S2, チェンソーマン 刺客篇, picks up.

ELSEWHERE ON THIS OWNER'S SHELF, if held: 'Chainsaw Man – The Compilation' (an S1 recap film, released 2025-09-05) is a recap → filler by rule; the 'Chainsaw Days' shorts released alongside it are described by the fandom as adapting the omake printed at the end of volumes 1-5 — omake serialized inside the source ARE the source (the GTO shape), so those are a canon/side_story question, not side_source. Neither is this work.
